title: Refried Bean Quesadillas
rawIngredients: 400g can pinto or kidney beans, rinsed and drained
200g tub fresh tomato salsa, plus extra to serve
Salt and black pepper to season
method: Heat the sunflower oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion and garlic for 2 mins.
Add the cumin seeds and cook for 1 min more.
Tip in the drained beans, smoked paprika, and a splash of water.
Using a potato masher, break the beans down as they warm through to make a rough purée. Season generously.
Spread the refried beans onto 4 of the tortillas, scatter over the grated cheese and coriander, and spoon over the salsa.
Top with the remaining 4 tortillas to create 4 sandwiches.
Wipe the frying pan with kitchen paper or heat a griddle pan. Cook each quesadilla for 1-2 mins on each side until crisp, golden, and the cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve warm with extra salsa and soured cream.
